blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Four times the quantity x minus three equals two times the quantity x plus five. Solve for x.
Distribute on both sides. Four x minus twelve equals two x plus ten.
Subtract two x from both sides. Two x minus twelve equals ten.
Add twelve to both sides. Two x equals twenty-two.
Divide both sides by two. x equals eleven.

Watch out for these traps. If you multiply only the x by four and leave the three alone, you get thirteen over two. If you multiply only the x by two and leave the five alone, you get seventeen over two.
